title: Stairmageddon
one_paragraph_synopsis: The office faces Stairmageddon, a stair-climbing event due to elevator maintenance, leading to conflicts and humorous incidents, including Stanley refusing to go out on a sales call, Dwight attempting to tranquilize Stanley, and discussions about personal journeys and career ambitions. The episode also features a documentary discussion and character interactions highlighting humor and workplace dynamics.
